profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary: An extremely dedicated and driven individual that wants to work and make a change. I love to build and create projects but also to learn from a strong team. Given my time programming and the various projects that I have worked on, I believe that I am a fast learner and am able to pick up new languages and software quickly.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Creating and supporting the development of multiple APIs using Spring. 
Worked on multiple projects as a Business Analyst to design and create functional requirements, documentation, and diagrams

positions.title: Learning Assistant/Remedial Tutor
positions.description: Tutor in all math subjects up to and including Calculus 2, as well as introductory computer science courses.

positions.title: Electrical Programmer
positions.description: Work with Arduino to install safety sensors and features within the fully electric go-kart that is being created.
